items.title: Sidney
items.overview: This revealing documentary honors the legendary Sidney Poitier—iconic actor, filmmaker, and civil rights activist. Featuring interviews with Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Halle Berry, and more.

items.title: Mickey: The Story of a Mouse
items.overview: Mickey Mouse is one of the most enduring symbols in our history. Those three simple circles take on meaning for virtually everyone on the planet. items.title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Deadpool & Wolverine
items.overview: Hugh Jackman, Ryan Reynolds, and director Shawn Levy sit down and spill the proverbial beans about how "Deadpool & Wolverine" was conceived, carried to term, and then birthed.

items.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
items.overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

items.title: STILL: A Michael J. Fox Movie
items.overview: A short kid from a Canadian army base becomes the international pop culture darling of the 1980s—only to find the course of his life altered by a stunning diagnosis. What happens when an incurable optimist confronts an incurable disease?

items.title: The Rescue
items.overview: The enthralling, against-all-odds story that transfixed the world in 2018: the daring rescue of twelve boys and their coach from deep inside a flooded cave in Northern Thailand.

items.title: Who Are You, Charlie Brown?
items.overview: Lupita Nyong'o narrates a documentary about Peanuts and its creator, Charles M. Schulz. Famous fans—including Drew Barrymore, Kevin Smith, and Al Roker—share its influence on them, and a new animated story finds Charlie Brown on a quest.

items.title: Beastie Boys Story
items.overview: Here's a little story they're about to tell... Mike Diamond and Adam Horovitz share the story of their band and 40 years of friendship in a live documentary experience directed by friend, collaborator, and their former grandfather, Spike Jonze.

items.title: Music by John Williams
items.overview: His unforgettable scores are an essential part of some of the most beloved movies of our time, over a career that spans decades. items.title: Stephen Curry: Underrated
items.overview: The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.

items.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
items.overview: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

items.title: Nǎi Nai & Wài Pó
items.overview: A multigenerational story celebrating director Sean Wang's two grandmothers, one on his father's side and the other on his mother's side.

items.title: Billie Eilish: The World's a Little Blurry
items.overview: This documentary offers a deeply intimate look at extraordinary teenager Billie Eilish. Award-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler follows her journey on the road, onstage, and at home with her family as the writing and recording of her debut album changes her life.

items.title: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
items.overview: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.

items.title: Deaf President Now!
items.overview: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world's only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

items.title: John Candy: I Like Me
items.overview: Those who knew iconic funnyman John Candy best share his story, in their own words, through never-before-seen archival footage, imagery, and interviews.

items.title: Jim Henson Idea Man
items.overview: Featuring unprecedented access to Jim Henson's personal archives, filmmaker Ron Howard brings us a fascinating and insightful look at a complex man whose boundless imagination inspired the world.

items.title: Makayla's Voice: A Letter to the World
items.overview: A teen with autism unlocks a joyous world of self-expression as she shares her voice for the first time using a letter board.

items.title: Louis Armstrong's Black & Blues
items.overview: Never-before-heard personal recordings and archival footage tell the story of Louis Armstrong's life from his perspective. From musical phenom to civil rights activist to world-renowned artist, this illuminating film shows sides of Armstrong few have seen.

items.title: Flee
items.overview: Recounted mostly through animation to protect his identity, Amin looks back over his past as a child refugee from Afghanistan as he grapples with a secret he’s kept hidden for 20 years.

items.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
items.overview: The scandalous world of a group of Mormon mom influencers implodes when they get caught in the midst of a swinging sex scandal that makes international headlines. items.title: Mayday
items.overview: Major real-life air disasters are depicted in this series. Each episode features a detailed dramatized reconstruction of the incident based on cockpit voice recorders and air traffic control transcripts, as well as eyewitnesses recounts and interviews with aviation experts.

items.title: Arena
items.overview: Arena is a British television documentary series, made and broadcast by the BBC. items.title: Panorama
items.overview: Current affairs programme, featuring interviews and investigative reports on a wide variety of subjects.

items.title: Great Performances
items.overview: The best in the performing arts from across America and around the world including a diverse programming portfolio of classical music, opera, popular song, musical theater, dance, drama, and performance documentaries.

items.title: Bares für Rares
items.overview: In the show, selected applicants each present a curiosity, rarity or antique they have brought with them. items.title: NOVA
items.overview: PBS' premier science series helps viewers of all ages explore the science behind the headlines. Along the way, NOVA demystifies science and technology, and highlights the people involved in scientific pursuits.

items.title: Fuse
items.overview: Fitil is a popular Soviet/Russian television satirical/comedy short film series which ran for about 500 episodes. items.title: Welcome to Wrexham
items.overview: Documentary series tracking the dreams and worries of Wrexham, a working-class town in North Wales, UK, as two Hollywood stars (Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds) take ownership of the town’s historic yet struggling football club.

items.title: The South Bank Show
items.overview: The South Bank Show is a television arts magazine show produced by ITV between 1978 and 2010. A new series began on Sky Arts from 27 May 2012. Presented by Melvyn Bragg, the show aims to bring both high art and popular culture to a mass audience.

items.title: STEVE! (martin) a documentary in 2 pieces
items.overview: Steve Martin is one of the most beloved and enigmatic figures in entertainment. Dive into his extraordinary story from two distinct points of view—past and present—as Martin reflects on how his beginnings led to his unexpectedly fulfilling life today.

items.title: Frontline
items.overview: Since it began in 1983, Frontline has been airing public-affairs documentaries that explore a wide scope of the complex human experience. Frontline's goal is to extend the impact of the documentary beyond its initial broadcast by serving as a catalyst for change.

items.title: Horizon
items.overview: Horizon tells amazing science stories, unravels mysteries and reveals worlds you've never seen before.

items.title: Democracy Now!
items.overview: A United States daily progressive, nonprofit, independently syndicated program of news, analysis, and opinion.

items.title: Document 72 Hours
items.overview: An unusual documentary series that delves into human dramas through chance encounters with ordinary people at selected spots. Filmed over 72 hours in a single location, the show captures glimpses into people's lives as they open up and share their stories.
